title: 第97章 那笔钱是美丽拿命换来的

第97章 那笔钱是美丽拿命换来的-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

李红霞抱着衣裳进了屋，把衣裳放在炕上，一件一件叠。

“你找美丽借钱？借多少？”

“就……就她那笔赔偿金。”

李红霞叠衣裳的手停了。

她看了林国栋一眼。

“她没借？”

“她不但不借，还把我数落了一顿！”

林国栋越说越气，“说什么我没本事，攒不住钱，钱借给我跟扔水里一样。

妈，你说她是不是太过分了？离了婚就不认娘家人了！”

李红霞没接话。

她低下头，继续叠衣裳。

一件灰布褂子，叠得方方正正。

林海柱从里屋出来，披着件旧棉袄，蹲在门槛上抽旱烟。

“爹，你给评评理！”

“评啥理。”林海柱磕了磕烟袋，“美丽不借，就对了。”

林国栋愣住了。

“你想做生意，本钱自己挣，挣不来，就别做。

从兄弟姐妹身上抠钱，抠了一回还想抠第二回？

美丽那笔钱是怎么来的，你不知道？你当哥的，好意思开那个口？”

林国栋脸上的血色褪得干干净净。

“爹，我……”

“你啥你，你大哥好歹自己凑钱开了店，你二哥白手起家干出来的。

你呢？你除了伸手，还会啥？”

林国栋嘴唇哆嗦着，说不出话。

李红霞把叠好的衣裳放进柜子里，转过身来：“老三，你爹说得对，我们老了，贴补不了你一辈子。

日子过成啥样，看你自己。”

林国栋看着李红霞，又看了看林海柱。

他忽然觉得，这个家真的变了。

以前他伸手要钱，妈给，爹虽然骂两句，最后也给。

现在他们不给了。

不但不给，还说他不对。

他站起来，摔门走了。

门框震了一下，墙皮簌簌掉下几片灰。

屋里安静下来。

李红霞站在柜子前，手搭在柜门把手上，半天没动。

“老头子。”

Li Hongxia carried the clothes into the house, put them on the kang, and folded them one by one.

"Are you asking Meimei to borrow money? How much?"

"Just...just her compensation."

Li Hongxia stopped folding clothes.

She glanced at Lin Guodong.

"She didn't borrow it?"

"Not only did she refuse to borrow it, she even scolded me!"

The more Lin Guodong talked, the angrier he became, "You said I have no ability and can't save money, so lending me money is like throwing it into the water.

Mom, do you think she went too far?Once you get divorced, you won’t recognize your mother’s family!"

Li Hongxia didn't answer.

She lowered her head and continued folding clothes.

A gray cloth gown, folded squarely.

Lin Haizhu came out of the back room, wearing an old cotton-padded jacket, squatting on the threshold and smoking a cigarette.

"Dad, give me some advice!"

"What's the point of commenting?" Lin Haizhu puffed on his pipe, "You can't borrow beauty, that's right."

Lin Guodong was stunned.

"If you want to do business, you have to earn the capital yourself. If you can't earn it, don't do it.

To steal money from brothers and sisters, do you want to steal money a second time?

You don’t know where the beautiful money came from?As a brother, how dare you say that?"

The blood on Lin Guodong's face faded completely.

"Dad, I..."

"What are you doing? After all, your eldest brother raised the money to open the store, and your second brother did it from scratch.

What about you?Besides reaching out, what else can you do?"

Lin Guodong's lips were trembling and he was speechless.

Li Hongxia put the folded clothes into the cabinet and turned around: "Lao San, your father is right, we are old and cannot support you for the rest of our lives.

How your life goes depends on you."

Lin Guodong looked at Li Hongxia and then at Lin Haizhu.

He suddenly felt that this family had really changed.

In the past, when he asked for money, his mother would give it to him. Even though his father would scold him, he would give it to him in the end.

Now they don't give it.

Not only did he not give it, he also said it was wrong.

He stood up, slammed the door and left.

The door frame shook, and a few pieces of dust fell from the wall.

The room fell silent.

Li Hongxia stood in front of the cabinet with her hand on the cabinet door handle and did not move for a long time.

"Old man."
